### **1\+ Years**


Workplace type


### **On\-site**


As a UI/UX Designer you will be presented with the important opportunity to innovate by studying and researching project challenges, cultivate curiosity, ideate and collaborate with talented crossfunctional minds, design the right things (using design thinking principles with an emphasis on user testing), and design the things right. You would collaborate with other designers, researchers, technologists, and business stakeholders to craft meaningful experiences for our customers through thoughtful design.


We are looking for a talented UI/UX Designer to create amazing user experiences across our website and applications. The ideal candidate should have an eye for clean and artful design, possess superior UI skills, and be able to translate high\-level requirements into interaction flows and transform them into beautiful, intuitive, and functional user interfaces.

**Responsibilities:**

* Perform visual design/interaction design creating and implementing user interfaces.
* Develop high\-fidelity wireframes and clickable prototypes in a clean, well\-structured, and easily navigable format.
* Work collaboratively with developers and other designers to build scalable solutions to improve the user experience.
* Work with stakeholders to determine requirements and delivers fully functional, secure and engaging digital solutions.
* Incorporate user feedback, design best practices, and business understanding into effective designs.  

Providing advice and guidance on the implementation of UX research methodologies and testing activities in order to analyze and predict user behavior.
* Contribute to team standards for “what is good experience design” and design quality, including keeping our UI design pattern library up to date.

**Requirements:**

* Any Bachelor’s degree or diploma, multimedia courses.
* You have demonstrable UI design skills with a strong portfolio and keen sensitivity to user\-system interactions.
* Hand on experience in Figma, Adobe XD, Photoshop, Illustrator or CorelDraw.
* You have good knowledge of color theory, typography layout and UX/UI design.
* You are up\-to\-date with the latest UI trends, techniques, and technologies.
* Practical experience in development of HTML5, CSS3, jQuery, Bootstrap, Javascript, (optional).
* You are dedicated, result\-focused, flexible and creative.
* You are a self\-motivated and strong collaborator, with the ability to manage expectations and conflicting needs.

title: ReactJS TL
description:
Lead a team of front\-end developers in delivering scalable and maintainable web applications using React.js.  

  



Own the architecture and technical decisions for complex UI features and front\-end systems.  

  



Mentor team members, conduct code reviews, and enforce development best practices.  

  



Translate product requirements into technical specifications and timelines.  

  



Collaborate closely with backend engineers, designers, DevOps, and QA to ensure end\-to\-end delivery.  

  



Drive performance optimization, cross\-browser compatibility, and responsive design.  

  



Manage task allocation, sprint planning, and ensure timely delivery of features.  

  



Ensure a high standard of UI/UX consistency and quality across the product.  

  



  

  

### **Requirements**

6\+ years of hands\-on experience with React.js, including Hooks, Context API, and Redux.  

  



Strong foundation in JavaScript (ES6\+), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3, and SCSS/SASS.  

  



Solid experience in designing component libraries, design systems, and atomic design structures.  

  



Familiarity with Next.js, Server\-Side Rendering (SSR), and static site generation.  

  



Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and JSON data handling.  

  



Experience working with Webpack, Babel, and front\-end build optimization.  

  



Expertise in unit testing frameworks (Jest, React Testing Library) and integration testing.  

  



Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, code versioning tools like Git, and tools like ESLint, Prettier.  

  



Experience deploying and scaling front\-end applications on cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP).  

  



Bonus: Exposure to micro frontends, performance profiling tools, and A/B testing frameworks.

title: Interactive Web Experience Designer
description:
###### **Design world\-class web experiences that power the digital face of grassroots cricket**


CricHeroes is the world’s largest cricket network, helping more than 50 million cricketers showcase their talent, gain recognition, and improve their game through data.


###### We’re looking for an **Interactive Web Experience Designer with 3–4 years of experience** who can combine UI/UX thinking, visual design, motion, and front\-end development to create compelling digital experiences for cricket communities worldwide.


###### **What You’ll Do**


###### **Web UI/UX Design**


* Design intuitive, visually compelling websites, landing pages, and interactive experiences.
* Own the process from user flows and wireframes to high\-fidelity UI, prototypes, and developer hand\-off.
* Create responsive, accessible, and consistent designs across devices and browsers.
* Build and maintain reusable components and design systems in Figma.
* Improve existing experiences using user feedback, analytics, and usability insights.

###### **Front\-End Design \& Development**


* Convert Figma designs into polished, responsive web pages using HTML5 and CSS3\.
* Use JavaScript to create interactions, transitions, and dynamic experiences.
* Write clean, reusable code and collaborate with developers to ensure design accuracy.
* Optimize web pages and visual assets for performance, accessibility, and SEO.

###### **Score Tickers \& Motion**


* Design and animate live score tickers, match graphics, scorecards, and cricket\-data experiences.
* Create engaging transitions and micro\-interactions using After Effects, Rive, Lottie, or similar tools.

###### **AI\-Assisted Design \& Innovation**


* Use AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, visual exploration, prototyping, content, and front\-end development.
* Evaluate AI\-generated work critically while maintaining originality, quality, privacy, and brand consistency.

###### **What We’re Looking For**


* 3–4 years of experience in web design, UI/UX design, or a related role.
* A strong portfolio featuring responsive websites, UI/UX work, and interaction or motion design.
* Advanced proficiency in Figma, including Auto Layout, components, variants, and prototyping.
* Strong working knowledge of HTML and CSS, with practical JavaScript skills.
* A strong eye for typography, colour, hierarchy, layout, and visual storytelling.
* Understanding of responsive design, accessibility, browser compatibility, and web performance.
* Experience with Photoshop, Illustrator, or comparable visual design tools.
* Strong communication, collaboration, problem\-solving, and attention to detail.
* Genuine interest in cricket, sports, or fan\-focused digital experiences.

###### **Added Advantages**


* Experience with Blender, Spline, Three.js, or other 3D tools.
* Familiarity with React, Webflow, Framer, WordPress, SVG animation or Canvas.
* Experience designing sports graphics, real\-time data interfaces, or broadcast experiences.

###### **About CricHeroes**


CricHeroes is the world’s largest cricket network, with more than 50 million users. It helps local cricketers showcase their talent, gain recognition, and improve their game with data.


We are made in India by passionate cricketers, for passionate cricketers around the world.


**Apply If This Sounds Like You**


If you’re excited to combine design, technology, motion, and cricket—and want to help build a one\-of\-a\-kind platform for cricketers worldwide—we’d love to hear from you.


Please apply with:


* Your updated résumé
* A portfolio featuring web UI/UX and responsive design work
* Links to live websites or front\-end projects you have worked on
* Motion, ticker, interactive, or 3D work, if available
* A brief note describing your contribution to each featured project

**Let’s build the future of cricket together.**


  
Join our team and change the way cricket is played forever. Please send your resume to talent@cricheroes.in
